intro: Five Guys is the build-your-own burger chain where a standard burger is actually a double, every one of the 15-plus toppings is free, and the fresh-cut fries are cooked in peanut oil and served overflowing. Hot dogs, milkshakes and the 'Little' single-patty burgers round it out. Below is the full Five Guys menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: Five Guys burgers come with two patties by default. A hamburger is about $13.87, a cheeseburger $14.95 and a bacon cheeseburger $15.95, with all 15+ toppings free. The 'Little' burgers are single-patty and cheaper, from $9.59. Regular fries are about $8.03 and famously huge, and milkshakes are $5.79.
hot_deal: Five Guys value tips: the regular fries are enormous, so one order easily feeds two. Order a 'Little' burger (still a full single patty) to save a few dollars, and load up on the free toppings, there are more than 15 at no extra charge. Milkshake mix-ins like bacon and Oreo are free too. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: Why is a Five Guys burger a double?
faqs.a: A standard Five Guys hamburger or cheeseburger comes with two patties by default. If you want a single patty, order the 'Little' version, which is cheaper and still a full burger.

faqs.q: Are toppings free at Five Guys?
faqs.a: Yes. Five Guys offers more than 15 toppings, from grilled onions and mushrooms to jalapenos and A.1. sauce, all at no extra charge on any burger, dog or sandwich.

faqs.q: How much is a Five Guys cheeseburger?
faqs.a: A regular (two-patty) cheeseburger is about $14.95 and a bacon cheeseburger is about $15.95. The single-patty Little Cheeseburger is around $11.87.

faqs.q: How big are Five Guys fries?
faqs.a: Famously huge. A 'regular' order is enough to share, and staff usually add an extra scoop into the bag. Fries are fresh-cut and cooked in peanut oil, and a regular is about 950 calories.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Five Guys?
faqs.a: The best known are the cheeseburger, the bacon cheeseburger, the overflowing fresh-cut fries, the Little Cheeseburger, and the hand-spun milkshakes with free mix-ins.
